name: Full-life
doc: Full-life (spell; the act family, Drain's master): once its children are gone the actor pools and the stage fade in, then one emitter per action - its sound, the actor system around its target, the master's release, the result (the revive); after the last action a wait, the stage fade out. Its parts are the port's code (FFNx mag027_fulllife.cpp) run on the program's memory.

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions and uses this memory.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs (its tasks the port's, its parts spawned by them): its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

act.doc: Drain's master in the act family's form: once its children are gone the actor pools carved from the arena top and cleared, the stage in task; after the last action its wait, the stage out task; the actor counters cleared every tick

parts.title: Emitter
parts.doc: One per action: its sound, the actor system, the master's release, the result (the revive); the master's wait

parts.title: Stage fade
parts.doc: The stage fade in (once the master's children are gone) and out (after the wait)

groups.label: Actor system
groups.doc: At the emitter's start: Start, Length (ticks), Mode (0: the targets' positions)

params.label: Release tick
params.doc: The master may start the next action at this tick

params.label: Result tick
params.doc: The action's result (the revive) from this tick

params.label: Wait
params.doc: After the last action, the fade out after these ticks

params.label: Level
params.doc: Its level (in: up to it, out: from it)

params.label: Step
params.doc: Up / down by this a tick

tasks.doc: One per action: the module's own emitter (the port's task): its sound, the actor system, the master's release, the result.
The stage fade in (the port's task: the fade layers cleared, their level up a step a tick).
The stage fade out (the port's task: from its level down a step a tick to 0).
